core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sabrine corresponds to the Arabic form صَابْرِين (Arabic root ص ب ر (ṣ-b-r); صَابِرِين (Ṣābirīn)). Its core sense is sabrine; a female given name. Sabrine is a spelling variant of Arabic صَابِرِين (Ṣābirīn) 'patient ones', used as a female given name. The source gloss 'Patient, gentle, and beautiful' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as sabrin.
